name: Brandeis University
header:
Brandeis University
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Past Coursework Question is easy to miss.
• Current English waiver wording says completed degree.
• An admissions event can unlock a fee waiver before submission.
• Paul Monsky, Alan Mayer and Gerry Schwarz are emeriti. Rebecca Torrey is current faculty with
number-theory expertise, but a recent research paper in the requested fields was not verified; the public
repository emphasizes mathematics pedagogy. Confirm her research-supervision role before treating her as an
advisor match.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
Bachelor's degree completed or in progress is accepted; UChicago satisfies the degree-type requirement. [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Check portal Past Coursework Question and statement prompt before drafting; seek an admissions-event fee
waiver before submitting. No financial proof required at initial application stage. [s1] [s4] [s5]
Adviser contact [Conflict]
Prior adviser agreement not publicly required. Verify supervisor availability directly; department currently lists
An Huang as DGS, whereas another official faculty listing still lists Tyler Maunu. [s8]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Current application: apply.grad.brandeis.edu; public FAQ covers references and postsubmission contact edits.
Initial financial documentation not required. [s5]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027 portal and January 15 Mathematics deadline explicitly published. Exact essay/coursework prompts
remain portal-only. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
English proficiency may be met by listed education/work waivers or a current test. Recommended TOEFL 5/old
100; IELTS 7; Duolingo 130; PTE 68. Official scores needed only after acceptance; valid 2 years at submission.
[s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A completed on-campus bachelor's with at least 3 full-time academic years taught only in English qualifies. If
degree still unfinished at submission, the word completed creates an ambiguity: obtain confirmation. Language
of instruction must be documented. [s3]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Optional for Mathematics; unofficial scores accepted in application, official on enrollment if used.5-year
validity; code 3092. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
Current page says GRE optional without distinguishing tests; older departmental search extract recommended
both general and subject. Department page now redirects. Confirm current subject-test recommendation; it is
not established as required. [s1]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [2027 confirmed]
Three; academic references preferred. [s1]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
No separate application for ordinary merit scholarships; no additional scholarship reference listed. [s6]
What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
Automated email invitations exist, but exact save/send trigger is not specified in public FAQ. [s5]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Applicant can submit before letters arrive; review is held pending all required materials. [s5]

Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
Applicant Status Portal has Recommendations page and invitation controls; explicit received-letter status
wording not verified. [s5]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
After submission one can edit email addresses, resend invitations, add recommenders. Replacement of a
submitted letter/prior-cycle reuse unverified. [s5]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Unresolved]
Math page promises competitive fellowship, full tuition and health insurance; dollar stipend and 2027 summer
coverage not publicly established. [s7]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Five years of PhD fellowship, full tuition scholarship and health benefits stated. [s7]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Domestic and international full-time applicants automatically considered for merit awards. [s6]
Conditions and duties; Other funding routes [Unresolved]
This particular funding term was not established by the public program/admissions material checked. Obtain

amount/duration is inferred from silence. [s1] [s2] [s3]

partner-program participants. Attend event before submitting. No citizenship exclusion is stated for event
route. [s4]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic geometry and representation theory
Justin Campbell
Geometric Langlands, geometric Eisenstein series, semi-infinite flags and parabolic induction. [faculty1]
[faculty1a]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2024 preprint · Proof of the geometric Langlands conjecture III: Compatibility with parabolic induction
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Algebraic geometry and number theory
An Huang
D-modules, periods, Hodge theory, mirror symmetry and zeta/L-functions; also p-adic mathematical physics
and graph theory. [faculty3] [faculty3a]
Associate Professor and Director of Graduate Study; new supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 · Approximation of L-functions associated to Hecke cusp eigenforms
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Algebraic and complex geometry
Bong Lian
Calabi-Yau geometry, periods, mirror symmetry, invariant theory and representation-theoretic connections to
string theory. [faculty5] [faculty5a]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 journal volume; revised arXiv 2026 · Restriction theorems: from orbits and Chevalley to periods and
Galois
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.

Number theory and representation theory
Omer Offen
Automorphic representations, distinguished representations and periods, local-global principles, L-functions
and Shimura lifts. [faculty7] [faculty7a]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · A note on gamma factors for pairs
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Representation theory
Kiyoshi Igusa
Quiver and cluster representations, stability conditions, exceptional sequences and connections to topology.
[faculty9] [faculty9a]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · Continuous Stability Conditions of Type A and Measured Laminations of the Hyperbolic Plane
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Number theory
Dmitry Kleinbock
Metric Diophantine approximation through homogeneous dynamics, Lie groups and lattices. [faculty11]
[faculty11a]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Density of the multidimensional Lagrange spectrum
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Keith Merrill
Diophantine approximation and dynamics, including approximation on abelian varieties. [faculty13] [faculty13a]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 preprint · Diophantine approximation on abelian varieties; a conjecture of M. Waldschmidt
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
